parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use correct trig expansions and obtain an equation in $\sin x$ and $\cos x$ - *M1. Use correct exact trig ratios for $30^\circ$ in the expansion - B1 FT; e.g. $\cos x(\sqrt3-1)=\sin x(2-\sqrt3)$. Obtain an equation in $\tan x$ - DM1; allow if the error in line 1 was a sign error. Obtain $\tan x=(2-\sqrt3)/(1-2\sqrt3)$ from correct working - A1 AG. Total: 4.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Obtain an answer in the interval, e.g. $173.8^\circ$ - B1; accept $174^\circ$, $354^\circ$ or better. Obtain a second answer and no other in the interval, e.g. $353.8^\circ$ - B1. Guidance: ignore answers outside the interval; treat answers in radians (3.03 and 6.17) as a misread. Total: 2.
